added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed run's manifest carries no baseline_suite or after_suite arm, so the added-failure count was not taken; the done-when delegates the importer population to the coordinator's merged-head run

artifacts.headline: done-when test file 2 passed; importer population 26 passed EXIT=0; negative control EXIT=1

findings.text: follow-on: the new _discarded_since (reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:436) repeats the 'was this run discarded' predicate already implemented privately as _discard_recorded; both wrap promotion.discard_record_path with an OSError guard, so a public predicate on the promotion owner would retire the duplication, but the change does not hold on it

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 4f4e5913: 444cc82f8 adds _discarded_since (reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:436-450) and its guard clause (reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:468-469), adds tests/test_a_discarded_request_stays_discarded.py (2 cases), and adds the evidence fragment; queue_admission.py is otherwise untouched.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_discarded_request_stays_discarded.py, whose test_a_request_discarded_during_the_pass_is_not_written_back discards mid-pass and asserts no pointer remains, and whose test_a_request_nobody_discarded_is_still_queued asserts the default; the manifest records the importer population (26 passed, EXIT=0) and negative_control.log (EXIT=1), but it carries no baseline_suite or after_suite, so the done_when's 'no added failure against base' half is named to the coordinator's merged-head population rather than measured here.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that the admission pass write a request back after a failed launch only when nobody discarded it during the pass; reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:468 returns from _restore_queued when _discarded_since (reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:436-450) finds the run's discard record, and _restore_queued is the pass's sole write-back of a failed launch, called only at reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:506.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commit 444cc82f8, changed_paths matching the three diff paths; it records the population gate at revision 444cc82f8 and negative_control.log whose last line is EXIT=1, and it declares no baseline_suite or after_suite arm.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the dispatch fenced reckon/crew/queue_admission.py, tests/test_a_discarded_request_stays_discarded.py, docs/evidence/fragments/a-held-dispatch-waits-its-fair-turn/a-discarded-request-stays-discarded.html and the figures directory; the diff lists exactly the first three and nothing outside them.

justifications.durability: removing the guard at reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:468 reddens tests/test_a_discarded_request_stays_discarded.py:63 with the discarded pointer reappearing, as the declared negative control's EXIT=1 shows; both cases read filesystem state rather than a value the test passed in.
justifications.evidence: the done_when's central measure is asserted by tests/test_a_discarded_request_stays_discarded.py:62-66 and recorded in the manifest with a red negative control, but the manifest carries no base arm so the 'no added failure against base' half rests on the coordinator's merged-head population, not on a run recorded here.
justifications.fit: _discarded_since (reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:436) and the deferred 'from reckon.crew.promotion import discard_record_path' at line 445 match the file's existing deferred-import idiom (lines 98, 118, 280, 310) and carry no version, plan or ticket identifier; ruff check on both changed files is clean.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the guard at reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:468 makes _restore_queued leave the pointer absent when promotion.discard_record_path(run_id) exists, and that function is the only place a failed launch is written back (reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:506), so a discard issued during the pass now stands.
justifications.reuse: _discarded_since wraps the owner promotion.discard_record_path rather than re-resolving the path, but its body duplicates the private predicate _discard_recorded (reckon/crew/recovery_watch.py:1494), the same try/except-over-discard_record_path shape already present.
justifications.scope_discipline: the landed diff lists only reckon/crew/queue_admission.py, tests/test_a_discarded_request_stays_discarded.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the four declared write paths.
